title: World of Chaotic Blocks
description: The project aims to add a new world type for a new survival effect.
body:
# World of Chaotic Blocks

**World of Chaotic Blocks** is a Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds a new custom world type with chaotic random block generation.

When you create a world with this type, the **Overworld no longer generates as normal terrain**. Instead, it becomes a huge empty space filled with blocks placed in a **three-dimensional grid**. Blocks appear every **10 blocks** on the X, Y, and Z axes, creating a strange floating world where every direction can lead to something unexpected.

The mod uses the loaded block registry, which means it can generate blocks from **vanilla Minecraft** and from **other installed mods**. Because of this, every modpack changes the experience. A small Forge setup will create one kind of chaos, while a large tech or adventure modpack can turn the world into something much more unpredictable.

**World of Chaotic Blocks is made for unusual survival and challenge runs.** Useful resources may appear nearby, but reaching them can be dangerous. Rare blocks may float above or beside you, but empty space stands between you and them. The world pushes you to explore, improvise, bridge across gaps, plan your route, and rely on a bit of luck.

The Nether and End remain mostly normal, so progression is still possible, but the Overworld becomes a completely different experience.

Some unsafe technical blocks are excluded from generation, such as air, portals, command blocks, structure blocks, and similar vanilla blocks. Selected Immersive Engineering multiblock parts are also excluded so they do not appear as broken structure pieces in the random grid.

## How to Use

Install **Minecraft Forge 1.20.1**, place the mod file in your `mods` folder, and create a **new world**.

Before creating the world, open the world settings and select the **World of Chaotic Blocks** world type.

> **Important:** The world type must be selected **before the world is created**.  
> Existing worlds cannot be switched to World of Chaotic Blocks through the normal in-game world settings.

Because the mod uses blocks from installed mods, the final generation depends on your modpack.~~~~
